hooks.command:
f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/CONTRIBUTING.md"; out=$(jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("CONTRIBUTING.md for this repository, injected at session start so its review checklist is in context before the change it governs is written.

" + .)}}' "$f" 2>/dev/null) && printf '%s' "$out" || printf 'The session-start hook could not read CONTRIBUTING.md. Read it before changing anything in this repository.
'
